overviewHtml:
During an incident the hard part is staying methodical under pressure. This prompt keeps the sequence consistent, from triage to root cause, and leaves a write-up behind that you can share.

What you get

  • All active Dynatrace problems checked in one sweep
  • Root cause explained in plain English
  • User impact, error logs and distributed traces per critical problem
  • Mitigation suggestions, business-impact priority and an incident report
getStartedHtml:
You need a Dynatrace environment, the Dynatrace for AI skills and a tool that reaches it (dtctl or the Dynatrace MCP server).

  1. Copy the prompt into your AI chat or prompt folder
  2. Run it when an incident is active
  3. Share the generated report with responders
